working_meaning.statement: A Lab Workspace is a durable, versioned operating scope bound to one explicitly selected primary subject of kind Product or Project. A Product workspace keeps its Product records, linked Project coordination and Work in one canonical home. A Project workspace binds one Project and may reference a Product or another declared purpose. It connects eight responsibility areas to an exact operating-model revision, accountable routes, source selections, configuration and lifecycle contracts. Workspace identity, subject identity, physical home, runtime instance and authority grants remain distinct. Shared operations and shared execution are the default; specialization does not require a runtime copy.

working_meaning.scope: Shared meaning for the Lab-owned Define integration and its explicitly named consumers. This proposed meaning does not adopt the upstream runtime or every historical package record.
working_meaning.statement: CyberAlchemy Define is the Lab capability outcome of making the meaning required for one bounded goal and its originating intent explicit for a named consumer. It identifies the declared required concepts, examines existing meanings and their source standing, exposes ambiguous or missing meaning and owner gaps, and records exactly one current disposition—reuse, specialize, propose or open—for every required concept in a reviewable Definition Pack. It preserves unresolved meaning and the intent that motivated the goal. It does not select the consumer solution, admit a Definition, assign an owner or grant execution authority. Its Product Capability instance must separately bind exactly one Product, scope, owner and outcome contract; the CLI and agent are realizations.
